title: The Qi-Carrying Straight Sword Manual
summary: A manual teaching students who circulate qi to carry it through a straight sword in cuts, thrusts and guards.

title: The Course of Edge and Breath
summary: A course that sets each cut and thrust of the straight sword to the breath and to the rhythm of qi.

title: Handbook of Binding the Blade
summary: A handbook of binds and crossings, teaching how to trap and control an opposing blade with qi.

title: The Straight Sword Second Course
summary: A second course for students who have finished the primer, deepening cuts and guards with steady qi.

title: Treatise on the Moving Point
summary: A treatise on keeping the point in motion so that feints, thrusts and recoveries stay linked.

title: The Half-Sword Grips Manual
summary: A manual of half-sword grips, with one hand on the blade, for close work against armor and in tight quarters.

title: A Workbook of Blade Crossings
summary: A workbook that drills students in the moment blades cross and what to do with the qi that follows.

title: The Cut-and-Recover Canon
summary: A canon that teaches each cut to end in a recovery, so the student's guard never stays open.

title: Principles of Sword Measure
summary: A treatise on measure, the exact distance between swords, with the cuts and steps that decide it.

title: The Stepping Edge Manual
summary: A manual that pairs a cutting edge with each step, so the student attacks while moving in any direction.
